headline.text: L3 ML1 Cavanna infeeder jammed repeatedly overnight—*4 hours total downtime*—while L2 battled plant-wide internet outages through both night shifts.

per_plant_summary.L1: All three Sollich lines ran through the window. S2 had a brief decorator temperature spike at 22:19 that cleared by 22:53, and maintenance is planning to drain buffer tank AD5 after a valve leak (no contamination risk confirmed). Matrix techs visited to tune MM6 and set up matrix 9 and 10.
per_plant_summary.L2: Internet dropped six times across the 24-hour window, disrupting NetSuite, labels, and floor connectivity—Alan opened another IT ticket at 09:16. ML2 completed a changeover from dark chocolate sea salt to milk crunch, managing temper swings after Sollich techs adjusted scraper motor settings. ML3 ran clean aside from two quick demolder jams that cleared in under 5 minutes each. Almond sorting for L1 is active with 3-person crews per Alan's directive.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 fought Cavanna infeeder jams and sensor faults through second and third shift—chocolate jammed twice requiring depositor drainage, sensor B1-150 misadjusted, vertical belt faulted at 22:19. Maintenance cleared it by 23:48, but more issues at 00:08. Bosch flow wrapper also struggled with film not sealing; tech had left, so the line ran Cavanna-only overnight. Depositor nozzle clogged at 05:09, cleared by 06:24. First shift restarted smoothly at 07:04.

notes.text: Matrix tech team recommended not changing cam settings on wrappers and emphasized physical adjustments over software tweaks.
Sollich techs changed ML2 depositor scraper motor speed from 30% to 50% and saved new tempering delta (1.5°C instead of 2°C) to the dark chocolate sea salt recipe.
Bosch tech installed a part on ML1 flow wrapper that must remain in place for correct product positioning—one screw currently, checking for second screw to prevent bending.

resolved.title: Decorator temperature spike on S2
resolved.summary: Temperature on decorator high at 1.2, line stopped while operator made adjustments.
resolved.resolution: Elizabeth posted "Line running now" at 22:53—34 minutes down.

resolved.title: Metal detector belt tracking west on S2
resolved.summary: MD belt tracking to west; lock for the wheel was keeping it active.
resolved.resolution: Caleb York found and fixed the lock issue at 16:36.

resolved.title: ML2 depositor temperature/temper out of spec
resolved.summary: Sollich techs adjusted scraper motor speed from 30% to 50%, causing temper to drop below spec; line stopped at 16:12.
resolved.resolution: Brandon Lance made temperature adjustments to mass cooling and water mixing stages at 20:11-20:24, depositing restarted at 16:32, temper brought back into range per screen at 21:33.

resolved.title: Speed door stuck at L2
resolved.summary: Speed door stuck, requested help at 05:54.

resolved.title: Cavanna infeeder jam on ML1
resolved.summary: Chocolate jammed in Cavanna infeeder requiring two depositor drainages and sensor adjustment; line down from approximately 19:52 through 23:48.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance determined sensor B1-150 wasn't adjusted properly (20:59), made corrections, line running at 23:48 and operator posted "Line currently running @ 11 mpm" at 00:08.

resolved.title: Keyence camera false detection on ML1
resolved.summary: Camera faulted repeatedly when no molds were present; laser eye reflecting off stainless steel at bottom of machine.
resolved.resolution: Leon Brueger moved the eye about 2 degrees to change reflection angle at 13:59, verified camera timing still good—"All Good."

resolved.title: C1 belt stopped 5 times on ML1
resolved.summary: Belt faulting for tracking, stopped five times between 13:22 and 13:48.
resolved.resolution: Nathan Ruiz adjusted tracking, posted "C1 belt is good now" at 13:53.

resolved.title: Lot code changed before super sack swap on ML1
resolved.summary: Operators changed lot code information before changing out the super sack, requiring line shutdown and sort of incorrect lot code product.
resolved.resolution: Frederick pulled rework team to sort 60 lbs off top of super sack, completed second inspection, line restarted at 01:40 per Raoul Lubain.

resolved.title: Right side depositor nozzle clogged on ML1
resolved.summary: Nozzle clogged during consistent production at 05:09, operators cleaning, then washed block and dosing heads.
resolved.resolution: Posted "Block and dosing heads cleaned" at 06:24, maintenance called at 06:20 but appears cleared by operator team.

resolved.title: Bosch printer shut off on ML1
resolved.summary: Printer turned itself off on Bosch flow wrapper at 08:04.
resolved.resolution: Restarted the printer at 08:17, posted "Restarting the printer and is now working."

resolved.title: Demolder jam on ML3
resolved.summary: Mold jam at demolder stopped line at 08:28.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance worked on it, line running at 08:32—4 minutes down.

needs_attention.title: S3 chocolate depositor tempering unit shut off
needs_attention.summary: Depositor tempering unit screen is dark, melting tank with chocolate is cold at 07:36.
needs_attention.status: Katya asked Dakota, Chris, Jody, and Curt why it's shut off at 07:36; no answer or resolution posted in the window.

needs_attention.title: S2 riser pump not working, enrober temp high
needs_attention.summary: Riser pump isn't working and enrober temperature is high at 10:04.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance on-site at 10:04. Victor posted "We are waiting for Temper" with screen at 10:58. No clear resolution posted; Curt asked at 10:02 to post restart but unclear if fully resolved.

needs_attention.title: Plant-wide internet outages at L2
needs_attention.summary: Internet dropped six separate times across the 24-hour window (18:34, 20:27, 01:08, 01:45, 02:26, 06:45), disrupting NetSuite access, pallet labeling, and floor connectivity.
needs_attention.status: Alan Todd opened another IT ticket at 09:16; internet was up at that time but pattern of repeated failures continues.

needs_attention.title: ML2 flow wrap piece missing
needs_attention.summary: Flow wrap component missing since start of first shift; team looked for it and it's lost.
needs_attention.status: Alan asked at 14:12 if anyone knew where it went; Brandon said operator and line lead confirmed it was there last night when they left. No resolution or location found.

needs_attention.title: ML2 flow wrapper vacuum hose broken
needs_attention.summary: Vacuum hose on FW damaged, reported on Teams at 3:15p on 09/01, raised again at 07:38 on 09/02.
needs_attention.status: Zack noted at 04:50 it was reported yesterday at 3:15p and just brought to his attention again; he asked Maintenance for replacement. Alan asked Dave Ruff at 07:40 if replacement hoses available—no answer in window.

needs_attention.title: Buffer water temperature low on ML1
needs_attention.summary: Buffer water temperature received low at 14:25.
needs_attention.status: Second-shift leader notified at 14:25; no follow-up or resolution posted in the window.

needs_attention.title: Bosch flow wrapper film not sealing on ML1
needs_attention.summary: Film keeps coming out open, maintenance notified at 18:41; tech had already left for the night.
needs_attention.status: Shawn and Bojana decided to run Cavanna only overnight at 18:59. First shift found part removed; Bosch tech explained at 08:19 it must stay installed and is working to add second screw to secure it. Angel activated NPNP sensor to prevent empty packages.

needs_attention.title: Cavanna product coming out open on ML1
needs_attention.summary: Product accumulating on Cavanna rails, sensor rejecting a lot, then 21% of sample coming out open at first shift.
needs_attention.status: Nathan Ruiz adjusting sensors at 08:05, Chris arrived at 09:09 to work with Nathan. Sample at 08:41 showed 21 out of 100 pieces open. Mirella posted seal check good at 10:51 thanking Nathan and Chris.
